column3: Saori Route ・ Venturing Into Akiba Once Again
Three days after the strategy meeting with Saori, I once again find myself stepping into the Holy Otaku Land of Akihabara.
But this time, I'm not here because I have a appointment with Saori.
The reason this time: my sister.
You want me to buy you a new game?!
Yeah.  You have nothing better to do, right?
You don't do anything but breathe in oxygen and breathe out carbon dioxide, anyway.
At least be of some use to me.
Who do you think you are?
I'm supposed to be preparing for entrance exams, you know?
Huuuh...
And so? How is that related to my life?
I just thought of taking a breather and going to Akiba for a while.
If that's the case, go by yourself.
No way.
It's so hot, and I really don't want to go to a popular area with lots of people.
Ah, so that's how it is.
In short, you're ordering me to take a break from studies, walk out there under the hot sun, and dry up from bathing in the intense rays of direct
sunlight.
Even I would snap at Kirino's selfishness, you know?
Today, as a brother, I need to have a stern talk with Kirino.
Can I just say something, Kirino?
I'm not your chauffeur, nor am I your handyman. I'm your---
You're not going?
I'd love to go!!
...See? I talked to her sternly, didn't I?
I wonder if this is also the effect of Kuroneko's bracelet...
Will something even worse happen later on, or will we get a visit from Lady Luck...?
Whatever happens, I gotta hurry up and get what she's looking for, then I can cool down in a nice air-conditioned room...
For now, let's make our way to the store on the Main Street Chuo-dori.
During weekends and holidays, Akihabara is filled with bustling crowds.
There are many people here, too. I start grumbling at the innocent passerbys walking down the street with me.
Every single one of them is wearing that easily-recognizable otaku fashion...
Where do you even buy those spiraling glasses nowadays? Even Manami wears normal glasses...
...Though they are a bit old-fashioned.
Wait, a girl with spiraling glasses?
Is that you, Saori?
The unintentional use of the question form is due to Saori's figure being too... you know.
What is that, a hollow shell? Are you trying to give off an impression of a soulless person?
The hollow shells of cicada are more plump nowadays, you know?
Walking unsteadily on the sidewalk, it looked as if Saori would be knocked onto the roadway by the burly man who appeared in front of her.
This isn't just bad; this is really bad.
Saori! Hey, Saori!
